criteria.title: Revisit decisions when workload, hardware, or safety assumptions change. - capstone composition
criteria.task: Defend the selected architecture, then reduce queue capacity3 to1 and replace the sink with an asynchronous adapter whose callback may be delayed past shutdown. security.scope: Original local teaching service/firmware models and synthetic data only. Physical work is a separately authorized dedicated-board task, not performed by authoring.
security.target: Original telemetry service, scripted adapter or firmware state model named in this exact criterion.
security.environment: C17 local process/model with bounded input and storage; native kernel work only in a disposable VM and physical work only on a dedicated teaching target when separately authorized.
security.attacker_capabilities: Chooses synthetic frame bytes, request timing, allowed completion order and explicitly injected model faults. Does not control trusted authorization or host security policy.
security.isolation: No external target, deployed equipment, credentials or real data; use private temporary files and process-local pipes/socket pairs. Never disable host mitigations or execute an invalid native control transfer.
security.defect: A security suite that rejects every request is a correct hardened service.
security.exposing_transition: Create a final service regression matrix crossing malformed frame, valid unauthorized frame, queue exhaustion, stale session event, partial output and shutdown. Introduce one original authorization-bypass mutation and one release-before-quiescence mutation separately. Show correct ordinary authorized output alongside intended negative-control rejection and retain minimized traces.
security.exploitability_limits: Only the stated synthetic effect, lifetime/resource violation or model selection error is claimed. A crash/diagnostic is not arbitrary code execution; physical/security enforcement is not inferred from a host model.
security.success_condition: Authorized valid workflows succeed; each deliberate defect fails a specific state/effect/lifetime assertion, not an unrelated build error. Residual same-process and ambient OS authority is documented.
security.repair: Restore the exact admission, ownership, progress, isolation or validity invariant specified in the task; compare the original local defective control with the corrected implementation.
security.regression: Check Authorized valid workflows succeed; each deliberate defect fails a specific state/effect/lifetime assertion, not an unrelated build error. Residual same-process and ambient OS authority is documented. Also retain an ordinary valid successful workflow and a deliberately faulty control that fails for the intended semantic reason.
security.residual_limits: Same-process memory discipline, actual adapter behavior, physical hardware, tool/model assumptions and unsupported threat capabilities remain separately bounded.

limitations: Selected integration objectives deepen actual parent topics; domain-level leaf assessments remain separately required
